Name: Miss Coriel's Unique Courtship Response CORE
Author: MissCoriel
Description:
[size=5]Wanted: Translators to make UCRC compatible with all languages, if interested send me a message.[/size]
[size=4][b]What does this mod do?

[/b][/size]UCRC opens up dating and birthday responses to all NPCs.  This is now a requirement for more immersive NPCs.  

For modders trying to make more immersive NPCs please read the [url=https://github.com/MissCoriel/UniqueCourtshipResponseCore/wiki]Wiki[/url] for specifics.

Recommended Mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3312]Miss Coriel's Unique Courtship Response 4: Happy Birthday[/url]

[b]2.1.1 Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Added console command: [/b]ucr_reload is a manual reload of CORE assets
[*][b]Added console command: [/b]ucr_check <NPC> is a command that extracts the UCR data from an NPC's dialogue.
[*][b]Added daily CORE dialog checks:[/b] The game will check itself to see if CORE is set.  Error messages will show if something prevents this.
[/list][b]2.0 Notes: [/b]Added new dialogue that covers Pregnancy and Adoption.  Please see the wiki for the new dialogue options.
[b]1.2.0 Notes: [/b]Added Jealousy responses.  These will reset themselves everyday so your spouse can always ask you if you're up to something.
[b]1.1.0 Notes: [/b]Fixed more spelling errors and is now the Primary Core for UCR.  Also fixed the update key check.
[b]1.0.3 Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Added Unique Jealousy responses:[/b] Allows NPCs not set to use Minerva's unique jealousy mod to be able to support it.
[*][b]Added 1.5 dialogue:[/b] New dialogue has been added for 1.5 (specifically the wilted bouquet)
[/list]

[b]Current Supported Languages:
[list]
[*]Spanish
[*]Chinese
[*]Turkish
[*]Korean
[*]Portuguese
[/list][/b][size=4]Come visit my [url=https://discord.gg/uSGNKNf]Cozy Apartment[/url][/size][size=5] if you have questions or need support![/size]

You do not need to ever pay money to access my mods/content or beta releases![/size]
